ground_pound.identity: Power runs on all six downs between the tackles, finished at the goal line.
ground_pound.constraints: Little explosive ceiling; a stacked box takes away its main plays.
ground_pound.travels: Its dives and powers travel to other books; its red zone run lean is a system choice that stays home.

lateral_spread.identity: Two to four lateral chains that stretch a defense sideways.
lateral_spread.constraints: Fumbles and bells both ways; weak in rain.
lateral_spread.travels: Its chain plays travel; the lateral success bonus comes from drilling chains every day and stays home.

boot_raid.identity: Reach the Launch Pad, then fire snap kicks.
boot_raid.constraints: Needs a reliable kicker; stalls when kick passes are denied.
boot_raid.travels: Its kick pass sets travel. The Launch Pad payoff is its kicking system, which stays home: in the PR #329 prototype, borrowed Boot Raid calls on the Launch Pad gained less than home calls (3.84 against 4.27 yards a play).

ball_control.identity: Mistake free possession that takes the points when they are there.
ball_control.travels: Its safe calls travel; the clock burn is a tempo system that stays home.

ghost.identity: Viper motion and pre snap confusion; the defense never knows where the playmaker is.
ghost.constraints: Shadow mirrors the Viper and takes it away.
ghost.travels: Its jets and counters travel as matchup calls; the motion system stays home.

stampede.identity: High tempo speed runs outside that exploit tired defenders.
stampede.constraints: Needs its own tempo to tire a defense.
stampede.travels: Its sweeps and speed options travel, best against a defense already tired. In the PR #329 prototype, borrowed Stampede calls on early downs lost about a yard a play against home calls.

chain_gang.constraints: Feast or famine; gives up bells.
chain_gang.travels: Its long chains travel as a chase package; its risk appetite is the head coach's, not the play's.

slick_n_slide.identity: Two back zone reads with run or kick pass options.
slick_n_slide.constraints: Reads need reps; borrowed reads lose their edge.
slick_n_slide.travels: Its two back looks travel as matchup calls; the read option rate stays home.

balanced.identity: No strong tendency; adapts to the situation.
balanced.constraints: Nothing to borrow: it has no identity of its own.

east_coast.identity: Short kick passes that move the chains; rhythm builds with each completion.
east_coast.constraints: A turnover or punt resets the rhythm.
east_coast.travels: Its quick kick chains travel; the rhythm meter is a system and stays home.

shock_and_awe.identity: Vertical kick pass bombs at maximum tempo.
shock_and_awe.constraints: Sacks and interceptions; feast or famine.
shock_and_awe.travels: Its deep shots travel; volume shooting and tempo fatigue are system level.

six_shooter.identity: Run heavy setup on downs 1 to 4, then pull the trigger in Kick Mode.
six_shooter.constraints: Needs field position before the trigger.
six_shooter.travels: Its late down sets travel; the phase shift is a system.

quick_strike.identity: Transition offense: score in 2 to 4 plays off turnovers and bonus possessions.
quick_strike.constraints: Short possessions leave its defense on the field.
quick_strike.travels: Its fast break calls travel; the transition bonus belongs to the system.

mousetrap.identity: Bait and switch: show predictable looks, then punish the over adjustment.
mousetrap.travels: Its counters travel as matchup calls; the bait phase is a whole game plan and stays home.

mismatch.identity: Find the weak link and attack it with the Viper.
mismatch.travels: Its Viper isolation calls travel as matchup calls.

ironclad.identity: Suffocating grind with maximum clock burn.
ironclad.travels: Its grind calls travel late with a lead; field position and turnover aversion stay home.

swarm.identity: Zone rally defense: everyone flows to the ball.
swarm.travels: Called on matchups against lateral books.

blitz_pack.constraints: Counters and draws carve empty gaps; DEF-06 measured about one more 30 yard play a game against it.
blitz_pack.travels: A short yardage and chase package; rated weak in long yardage (long_yardage_modifier 1.20).

shadow.constraints: Power runs beat the undermanned box.
shadow.travels: Called on matchups against Viper books.

fortress.identity: Stack the box and own the line of scrimmage.
fortress.constraints: Kick passes and laterals stretch the edges.
fortress.travels: A short yardage and goal line package.

predator.constraints: A wrong guess is a touchdown.
predator.travels: A long yardage and chase package.

drift.identity: Soft zone, bend but don't break.
drift.constraints: Gives up four or five yards a carry.
drift.travels: A long yardage, lead protection and two minute package.

chaos.constraints: Wide open once the offense adjusts.
chaos.travels: A short yardage and chase package.

lockdown.constraints: Forces a ground game through a lighter box.
lockdown.travels: A long yardage, kick range and lead protection package.
